M1.notes: Trained on the generator's junkiness sweep rather than the cohort, so signal quality needs no patient history.

M4.notes: Trained on synthesized repetitions across the quality range, so scoring works from the first session.

M12.notes: KMeans over scale free trajectory shape features. Archetype names are mapped from centroid geometry at fit time, never from cluster index.

M6.notes: Isolation Forest over session features. Direction is assigned against the patient's own trailing mean, so a standout session is not reported as a problem.

M7.notes: Ridge predicting Borg CR10 from session measures. The residual, not the prediction, is what gets surfaced.

M13.notes: Logistic regression on session cadence. The disengagement label is constructed from prescribed and completed dates, not read from a column.

M14.notes: Empirical percentile curves by age band and sex. Small cells are pooled across adjacent age bands and the result reports that it pooled.
